description: Source code for torch.autograd.profiler_util module, providing classes and functions for profiling and analyzing performance of PyTorch operations, including event lists, profiling events, and table formatting.

classes.name: EventList
classes.description: A list of profiling events with helper methods for analysis and visualization.

classes.name: FormattedTimesMixin
classes.description: Mixin providing formatted string properties for timing attributes.

classes.name: Interval
classes.description: Represents a time interval with start and end in microseconds.

classes.name: FunctionEvent
classes.description: Represents a single profiling event with detailed timing, memory, and hierarchical info.

classes.name: FunctionEventAvg
classes.description: Aggregated profiling statistics over multiple FunctionEvent objects.

classes.name: StringTable
classes.description: A dictionary that demangles and manages string representations of event names.

classes.name: MemRecordsAcc
classes.description: Acceleration structure for accessing memory records within a time interval.

methods.name: table
methods.description: Formats an EventList as a readable profiling table.

methods.name: export_chrome_trace
methods.description: Exports profiling events to Chrome tracing format.

methods.name: export_stacks
methods.description: Exports stack traces with specified metrics.

methods.name: key_averages
methods.description: Computes averaged profiling statistics grouped by operation.

methods.name: total_average
methods.description: Computes aggregate statistics across all events.

methods.name: supported_export_stacks_metrics
methods.description: Returns list of supported metrics for exporting stacks.
